summary.text: Sword Tongue Dragon Soul is an immortal killer move.

claims.text: In Primordial Domain, Fang Yuan’s main body fights Star Constellation Immortal Venerable. He roars, his body shakes, and over a hundred evil dragons rapidly condense around him and charge her. She notes that they contain profundities of at least transformation path and enslavement path. Surrounding starlight splits into a thousand specks, each becoming one of her. Immortal Zombie Giant Sun tries to distinguish the real body. Fang Yuan still orders the dragons forward, and they fight her illusions until the battlefield turns chaotic.

The evil dragons bite, swing their tails, stab with their horns, or use their claws. Some shoot sharp sword qi with their tongues. At first the illusions are caught off-guard and suffer heavy losses. They then realize the dragons’ patterns, stabilize, and counterattack. Each illusion has one killer move, with only six kinds altogether, but their cooperation is high. About ten illusions attack one evil dragon and kill it after sacrificing several. The dragons decrease rapidly.

Immortal Zombie Giant Sun evaluates that sword tongue dragon soul has enslavement path profundity, so the dragons can be controlled, but Fang Yuan is far from Star Constellation Immortal Venerable’s match in wisdom path. Fang Yuan knows this, so carefully controlling the dragon souls would not be worth the effort; he activates the move repeatedly instead. He uses no other methods for a time and keeps activating it. Groups of evil dragons numbering over a hundred each continue to rush the battlefield. They are killed, but they soon gain the upper hand in overall strength.

Immortal Zombie Giant Sun then sees that the move contains soul path as well. After the evil dragons are annihilated, their souls appear. At first those dragon souls are extremely weak, with battle strength only ten percent of the evil dragons. As more die, scattered soul path dao marks in the battlefield surge, and the dragon soul beasts born from those deaths grow stronger: twenty percent, forty percent, sixty percent. Their battle strength keeps rising until they defeat the illusions and tilt the fight in Fang Yuan’s favor. When only dozens of illusions remain, her main body can no longer stay hidden. She smiles at Fang Yuan and retreats from the battlefield.
